summary: Students taking or retaking cross-listed courses should note how credit is recognised and how retakes must be registered. A cross-listed course registered under another major's course number is credited as a General Elective (일반선택). To retake a cross-listed course, students must register for the section offered under the course number they originally completed.
applies_to: Students who take, or wish to retake, cross-listed (Cross-listing) courses. The notice gives no limit by program, year of admission or nationality. It is guidance, not a required action.
conditions: If you take a cross-listed course offered under another major that is not your own, the credit is recognised as a General Elective (일반선택).
Your transcript records the course under the major's course number for which you registered.
To retake a cross-listed course, you must register for the section offered under the course number you originally completed.
Example: if courses A and B are cross-listed and you completed A, you can retake it only by registering for A; registering for B does not count as a retake.
steps: When registering for a cross-listed course, check which major's course number you are registering under, because the credit and transcript entry follow that course number.
To retake a cross-listed course, register for the section offered under the course number you originally completed (for example, register for A if you completed A).
translation:
Notes on Taking Cross-Listed Courses

Please review the following notes on completing cross-listed (Cross-listing) courses.

※ Please note that if you take a cross-listed course offered under another major that is not your own, the credit will be recognised as a General Elective (일반선택).

○ (Credit recognition) When a student takes a cross-listed course, the grade is recorded on the transcript as completion of the course of the major under which the student registered.

○ (Retaking) A student who wishes to retake a cross-listed course must register for the section offered under the course number of the course previously completed.

※ If courses A and B are cross-listed and a student who has completed course A wishes to retake it, the student can retake it only by registering for course A, the course previously completed.
